_comment: The DEPLOYED loop's HUD mask: BlueStacks + Nulls Brawl, at the same 2002x1126 normalized
viewport as brawl_vision/data/hud_mask.json and in the same format. That file describes the
iOS recordings' Layout A and stays what the offline tools read; on these frames its
attack/super rects sit on floor while every real button is uncovered. Measured 2026-09-14.
HOW: for each of the three BlueStacks fixture clips, the share of 2 Hz frames in which a pixel
matches its own temporal median (max channel difference <= 18). The camera follows the hero,
so the world scrolls and only screen-anchored UI stays put. Every opaque element below came
out as the same box in all three clips (share > 0.7 in each); boxes are padded ~15-25 px.
The attack button is semi-transparent and so only faint in that map; its rect is read off
the frames. The kill-feed card is transient and was read off a 3 s contact sheet, where it
is up in roughly half the samples.
NOT COVERED, deliberately: the long orange banner behind the kill card (one clip, ~9 s,
x to ~830). Masking it for good would blind a sixth of the frame's top half for a rare event;
what it deposits is left to the occupancy map's re-validation.
GOES STALE if the game's UI scale, the emulator, or the capture crop changes.
notes: BlueStacks / Nulls Brawl, Solo Showdown, measured 2026-09-14.

rects.name: brawlers_left
rects.note: match-state readout, top left; static text x[42,378] y[38,88].

rects.name: ping
rects.note: connection bars, top centre; static x[790,876] y[38,86].

rects.name: kill_feed
rects.note: kill card under brawlers_left, x[0,425] y[130,240]; transient, up about half the time.

rects.name: emote_bubble
rects.note: emote button, right edge; static x[1814,1914] y[518,604].

rects.name: attack_button
rects.note: large semi-transparent red crosshair, centre ~(1825, 857) r ~95; read off frames.

rects.name: button_cluster
rects.note: three round buttons as ONE rect: static x[1478,1574] y[996,1090], x[1580,1676] y[894,990], x[1696,1802] y[990,1098]. One rect because they glow and grow when charged, and the gaps between them are under a cell wide.

rects.name: exit_button
rects.note: Nulls Brawl 'Exit', bottom centre; static x[922,1070] y[998,1084].

rects.name: joystick_held
rects.note: where the deploy loop HOLDS the stick: control_calibration's anchor, (345.6, 669.6) device = (360, 698) viewport. The knob's 92 px (device, 96 viewport) throw plus its own ~54 px radius reach ~150 px out; the ring is r ~100. The loop never releases the contact mid-match, so in play this is the stick's only position, and bluestacks-example3 shows it here with the rest spot empty.

rects.name: joystick_rest
rects.note: where the stick sits with NO contact: ring static at x[60,290] y[788,1090] across bluestacks-example-new and -zone. Seen before the loop's first touch and after a release.
